title: A spacecraft touched an asteroid 320 million km away
description: In October 2020, NASA's OSIRIS-REx spacecraft touched down on asteroid Bennu to collect a sample of pristine solar system material. The mission successfully returned over 100 grams of pristine space rock back to Earth in 2023.

shots.narration: Watch this rocky surface, more than 320 million kilometres away from Earth.
This is Bennu, a rubble-pile asteroid about 500 metres wide.
OSIRIS-REx reached the asteroid in December 2018 to study its rocky surface.
Here, on 20 October 2020, the sampling arm touches the surface for a few seconds.
The surface gave way like a ball pit as the arm sank about half a metre before thrusters pulled it back.
The mission collected 121.6 grams, the largest sample returned from beyond the Moon.
The sample capsule landed in the Utah desert on 24 September 2023.
The rocks on this asteroid contain water-bearing minerals and organic molecules.
Bennu has about a 1-in-2,700 chance of hitting Earth in the year 2182.
